stem: A technician entered the wrong room ID in a treatment record and notices the error later. Which correction best preserves traceability?
choices: Use the approved correction process to preserve the original entry, add the corrected value, reason, date/time and responsible person
Leave the error unchanged so the audit trail is not touched
Create a new unrelated record without linking it to the original
rationale: A trustworthy audit trail preserves what was originally recorded and documents the correction rather than erasing history.
